understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to move every selectable piece onto a goal tile marked '+'; when multiple goals existed, all of them had to be occupied simultaneously to win the level and complete the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement actions shifted the selected piece by one grid cell, equivalent to 3 pixels, unless blocked or affected by an obstacle. Adjacent pushable blocks could be moved along with the piece, while walls and boundaries could prevent movement. Different obstacles did not always behave identically, so movement had to be tested. CLICK switched control to another selectable piece using its pixel/grid position.
